characters.continuity: The Witcher video game series (The Witcher, The Witcher 2: Assassins of Kings, The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt) and The Witcher comic series (Dark Horse Comics)
characters.summary: Geralt of Rivia is a genetically mutated professional monster hunter known as the White Wolf. He combines expert swordsmanship with steel and silver blades, the use of five magical combat Signs, and consumption of alchemical mutagens and potions to enhance his combat attributes.

techniques: Fast and strong sword attacks (strong attacks ignore armor)
Aard: a telekinetic wave that throws back, knocks down or stuns
Yrden: a magical ground trap that wounds and immobilises
Axii: briefly turns an enemy into an ally

mechanisms: Mutations give high resistance to injury, poison and disease

weaknesses: Toxicity limits from consuming too many alchemical potions
Vulnerability to certain magical effects and specialized monster conditions

depictions.title: The Witcher 2: Assassins of Kings (2011 video game)
The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt (2015 video game)

mobility: Running, rolling, dodging, and horse riding (Roach)
limitations: Potion toxicity caps the number of alchemical substances he can ingest at once.
Signs cost Stamina; when it runs out he must rely on Adrenaline to cast (Witcher 3 skills)
Potions add Toxicity; drinking past his overdose threshold is limited

sources.supports: Geralt's role as a mutated monster hunter, sword combat, and use of signs.

Witcher mutations from the Trial of the Grasses give high resistance to injury, poison and disease; monster slayer for hire; horse Roach; faces the Wild Hunt in The Witcher 3.
What each of the five Signs does (Aard, Igni, Yrden, Quen, Axii); Signs cost vigor/stamina. Descriptions quoted there are from The Witcher 2; the same five Signs are used in The Witcher 3.
The Witcher 3 skill trees: fast and strong sword attacks, strong attacks ignore armor, parry deflects arrows, Signs via Stamina or Adrenaline, potion Toxicity and overdose threshold.
Main quest 'On Thin Ice': Geralt kills Caranthir and then Eredin, king of the Wild Hunt, aboard Naglfar.

characters.continuity: Warcraft video game series (Warcraft III: Reign of Chaos, Warcraft III: The Frozen Throne, World of Warcraft: The Burning Crusade, World of Warcraft: Legion) and Warcraft comic series
characters.summary: Illidan Stormrage is the first demon hunter, a blinded night elf infused with fel energies who wields the Warglaives of Azzinoth. He blends acrobatic martial prowess with destructive fel magic, mystical sight, and demonic transformations.

techniques: Fel energy (tore Gul'dan apart with it)
Demon hunter Eye Beam and Throw Glaive (class signature abilities; Illidan is the first demon hunter)

mechanisms: Immunity or high resistance to fel and shadow corruption
Not established by the cited sources

weaknesses: Vulnerability to specialized Holy magic and powerful binding artifacts

Warcraft III: The Frozen Throne (2003 video game)
World of Warcraft: The Burning Crusade (2007 video game)
World of Warcraft: Legion (2016 video game)

mobility: Natural flight with wings, spectral leaps, and rapid dashes
Unfolds demonic wings for gliding descents; double jump and vault (demon hunter abilities)
limitations: Requires immense demonic energy control to prevent internal corruption or loss of self.
His eyes were burned out by Sargeras; he sees through orbs of mystic fire that perceive magic (spectral sight)
Demon hunters must keep their inner demon in check; Metamorphosis risks the demonic power taking over

Illidan's history: Warglaives of Azzinoth, eyes burned out by Sargeras and replaced with mystic-fire orbs, Legion: kills Gul'dan with fel energy at the Nighthold, kills Xe'ra on Argus, becomes Sargeras' jailor.
Illidan is the first demon hunter; demon hunters' spectral sight, warglaives, Metamorphosis, wing gliding, Eye Beam and Throw Glaive, and the risk of the inner demon taking over.

characters.continuity: Animal Crossing series (New Leaf, New Horizons, Super Smash Bros. Ultimate)
characters.summary: Isabelle is a cheerful and helpful secretary who utilizes everyday tools, office supplies, party goods, and town amenities to surprising effect in crossover combat engagements.

techniques: Party popper (forward smash, her most reliable KO option)
Fishing Rod: grabs and throws opponents from farther than her normal grab
Lloid Trap: a planted gyroid that fires when an opponent walks over it

mechanisms: Pocket: catches an opponent's projectile and can fire it back

weaknesses: Lacks innate offensive superpowers or heavy armor protection
Light and floaty, so she is easy to launch and struggles to return to the ground safely
Balloon Trip recovery is among the most easily edgeguarded

limitations: Relies on standard tools and comedic items rather than lethal weaponry.

characters.continuity: Pokémon series and Super Smash Bros. series
characters.summary: Jigglypuff is a balloon-like Pokémon that utilizes soothing vocal performances to put opponents into a deep slumber before unleashing an incredibly powerful, close-range counterattack known as Rest.

techniques: Sing: puts nearby opponents to sleep (longer the more damaged they are)
Rest: falls asleep and deals a single hard hit to opponents touching it
Pound: punch with large shield damage

mechanisms: Five midair jumps for aerial evasion
Light, floaty body that is hard to combo

weaknesses: Extremely lightweight and easily launched great distances when hit
Falls asleep immediately after using the Rest technique
Very light, so it is knocked out at low damage
Instantly KO'd if its shield is broken
Rest has extremely high ending lag and is easy to punish if it whiffs

depictions.title: Pokémon Red and Blue (1996 video game)
Super Smash Bros. Ultimate (2018 video game)

mobility: Multiple mid-air jumps and floating drift
limitations: Vulnerable to counter-attacks while sleeping after executing Rest.
Second-lowest weight and jump force in the game

SmashWiki: Jigglypuff's special moves (Rollout, Pound, Sing, Rest), five midair jumps, light weight and floatiness, shield-break KO, Rest ending lag.

feats.claim: Put opponents to sleep with its lullaby and landed precise Rest attacks in tournament bouts.

techniques: Handgun and assault rifle precision marksmanship
Grenade launcher and explosive mine deployment

mechanisms: First aid spray and green herb healing
Dodges incoming attacks at close range

weaknesses: Human physical limitations requiring tactical positioning and ammunition management
Ordinary human vulnerable to infection: Nemesis infected her with the T-virus and she needed Carlos's vaccine
limitations: Dependent on ammunition availability for firearms and heavy weaponry.
No superhuman powers; relies on weapons and equipment
